apps.author: azahar-emu
apps.name: Azahar
apps.changeLog:
This a minor release for the 2126 branch which primarily addresses a reported security advisory.
It also includes several newly backported improvements and fixes from the master branch.

Users are advised to update as soon as is convenient.

---

# Azahar 2126.2 Changelog

# All

- Addressed an oversight which allowed specially-crafted CIA files to execute arbitrary code in the host environment when locally installed by a user. | @PabloMK7 #2648 
  - Addresses the following GHSA report: https://github.com/azahar-emu/azahar/security/advisories/GHSA-h74v-5mw8-qg8r
- Fixed an issue where the xBRZ texture filter would be applied incorrectly when using the Vulkan renderer, resulting in an incorrect appearance. | @OpenSauce04 #2647 
- Handling of large HTTP downloads within emulated 3DS applications has been improved, improving memory efficiency and stability. | @PabloMK7 #2515 
   - Fixes downloading large games from the eShop. 
- Added a new 3GX loader flag `allow_homebrew_load`, which allows loading 3GX plugins for homebrew apps if the plugin supports it. | @PabloMK7 #2649

# Desktop

- Various improvements to GDB and RPC servers, fixing certain issues and improving functionality. | @PabloMK7 #2631, #2640, #2633
  - For additional info, see individual PR descriptions.
  - Script developers will need to update the RPC client as this is a breaking change. 

# Android

- Fixed a crash which could occur if the `gpu_drivers` directory contained a subdirectory. | @ygordreyer #2592

# Technical

- Creating a copy of the kernel shared and config pages using svcMapProcessMemoryEx is now possible.
  - This is a technical accuracy change. Little to no end-user impact.

apps.author: Trixarian
apps.name: NetherSX2
apps.changeLog:
Merry Christmas, Happy Holidays and a Happy New Year everyone!

This update adds experimental Online Multiplayer to NetherSX2 along with the usual updates!
Thanks to [IamLupo](https://github.com/IamLupo) for adding it to ARMSX2, and [zakilj3](https://www.youtube.com/user/zakilj3) for discovering the same settings work with NetherSX2!

[VirusTotal Scan Report](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/2029e30dcc1ba1ecb8d73313f18b429b40e6044c7785c52af08b948ef94b3ddf)

## How to use Online Multiplayer
1. Go to your App Settings --> Settings and toggle on Enable DEV9 Ethernet
2. Set API to Sockets, and Device to how you want to connect online with the default being WiFi. Set this to VPN if your phone uses a VPN, and to one of the two SIM DATA options if you want to use your Mobile Data Plan instead
3. That should be enough to get you online using a guide like [this](https://youtu.be/dcOnZzzcbSc?si=WOf01r0Ln5ZVQkpf&t=278) by LogicalMacrochip

You can use the [Official List of PlayStation 2 Online Games (2024)](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/15pfhL36qmC-iKr8MNjNXNLwgacG4VOmkfvwVxV5vGzo/edit?gid=0#gid=0) to figure out what games work, get their DNAS bypass codes if needed and which private server you should be using

For more advanced options (or you want to use the second method from the guide by LogicalMacrochip), you can do the following:
1. Set DNS1 Mode to Manual
2. Under DNS1 select either [PS2 Online](https://ps2online.com) (called Cristian in the Official list) or [PSRewired](https://psrewired.com)
Note: This can also be changed on a Per Game Settings and more servers will be added soon
To turn it off just set DNS1 Mode to Auto and DNS1 to 0.0.0.0

[zakilj3](https://www.youtube.com/user/zakilj3) created a more [comprehensive guide](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uZzEXvNXUUU) to make it easier for people
